# glad OpenGL loader

These files were generated by glad 2.0.8 for OpenGL 4.3 core with no extensions:

```text
python -m glad --api gl:core=4.3 --extensions= --out-path <output> --reproducible c
```

The generated files carry the SPDX expression
`(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0` in their headers. They are checked in so a normal
project build does not require glad's Python/Jinja generator environment.
